mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 60%) or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below 100.0), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100.0), the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST above 1400.0 thousand units) reflects strong consumer confidence and robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 1400.0, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases (i.e., positive returns < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 60%) or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS above 4.5%), policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases (i.e., negative returns < 50%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
